title: Structure-Aware Skill Retrieval and Arbitration for Optimization Modeling
title_zh: 面向优化建模的结构感知技能检索与仲裁

paragraphs.en: 提出ArchOR技能智能体，通过质心表示学习与结构签名检索优化LLM优化建模，在五基准上超越OptSkills。 Large Language Models (LLMs) can turn natural-language optimization tasks into solver-checked answers, but current agents remain brittle under narrative rewrites and often store reusable experience at the instance level. We introduce \textsc{ArchOR}, an archetype-centric skill agent that builds on \textsc{OptSkills} by adding two retrieval-focused modules. \emph{Centroid-Aware Representation Learning} (CARL) refines the ordering of cached skill representations through a low-rank prototype residual. \emph{Signature-Guided Retrieval} (S\textsuperscript{3}R) attaches open-dimensional structural signatures to skills, prioritizes candidates by weighted Jaccard overlap, and bounds semantic re-ranking to a top-$K$ set. A baseline-preserving arbitration rule determines when the structural route should replace the original selector. With the same DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone and released skill library, \textsc{ArchOR} reaches 65.00\% Micro-Avg.\ Pass@1 across five benchmarks, improving over \textsc{OptSkills} by 1.64~pp Micro-Avg.\ and 2.68~pp Macro-Avg.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ArchOR技能智能体，通过质心感知表示学习与结构签名检索优化LLM优化建模，在五基准上超越OptSkills。 大语言模型（LLMs）可以将自然语言优化任务转化为经求解器验证的答案，但当前的智能体在叙述改写下仍然脆弱，且往往只在实例层面存储可复用经验。 我们提出\textsc{ArchOR}，一个以原型为中心的技能智能体，它在\textsc{OptSkills}的基础上增加了两个面向检索的模块。\emph{质心感知表示学习}（CARL）通过低秩原型残差来优化缓存技能表示的排序。\emph{签名引导检索}（S\textsuperscript{3}R）为技能附加开放维度的结构签名，通过加权Jaccard重叠对候选进行优先级排序，并将语义重排序限定在top-$K$集合内。 一种保持基线的仲裁规则决定结构化路线何时应替代原始选择器。 在使用相同的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash骨干模型与已发布的技能库的情况下，\textsc{ArchOR}在五个基准上达到65.00\%的Micro-Avg.\ Pass@1，相比\textsc{OptSkills}在Micro-Avg.上提升1.64~pp，在Macro-Avg.上提升2.68~pp。
